messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] cannot install pystan 2.4.0 (OS X Mavericks)
parts:
I just found this email thread and I thought it would be worth pointing out that I had problems upgrading to Pystan v 2.4.0.2 on OS X Mavericks. When I installed pystan from source, I kept getting a similar error:
distutils.errors.LinkError: command 'c++' failed with exit status 1

I never found a way around it and I was only able to get pystan working again by deleting all pystan modules and reinstalling v2.3.0.0 from source. Works great now, but there does appear to be a problem with updating pystan on OSX 10.9

Nate
